people-who-know-whats-going-on-with-me.title: People who know what's really going on with me
people-who-know-whats-going-on-with-me.line: A few people know what I'm worried about this month and what I'm looking forward to, because I've told them and they remember.
people-who-know-whats-going-on-with-me.writerNotes: The core of 'anyone who really knows me': being known in depth by a small circle. Why test: wanting to be known is the end state itself, not a route to something else in this pain. Swap test: No support is about getting help in a crisis and Belonging about fitting a group; this is about people holding my current life in mind. Distinct from the honesty dream (what I can say) and the daily-conversation dream (how often).

talking-most-days-with-someone-who-knows.title: Talking most days with someone who knows me well
talking-most-days-with-someone-who-knows.line: Most days I have at least one conversation that goes past small talk with someone who knows me well.
talking-most-days-with-someone-who-knows.writerNotes: The direct answer to 'most days I don't talk to anyone', with the added detail that the talk goes past small talk so it isn't a bare restatement. Why test: a regular real conversation is wanted for itself. Swap test: Plans is about having company to go out with, not daily talk. Distinct by frequency; flagged as possible overlap with being known and with telling someone about my day.

someone-would-notice-if-i-went-quiet.title: Someone who'd notice if I went quiet
someone-would-notice-if-i-went-quiet.line: If I didn't answer my phone for a few days, someone who knows me would notice and get in touch to check on me.
someone-would-notice-if-i-went-quiet.writerNotes: Being missed: someone keeps track of me without my asking. Why test: wanting to be noticed is part of mattering to someone, the end state, not a means. Swap test: No support is about having someone to call when I need help, where I reach out; here the other person notices first. Growing old alone is about older people near me. Flagged against the being-known dream, which it may sit inside.

someone-to-tell-about-my-day.title: Someone to tell about my day
someone-to-tell-about-my-day.line: When something small happens, good or annoying, I have someone to tell that evening who knows why it matters to me.
someone-to-tell-about-my-day.writerNotes: Sharing the ordinary as it happens, which people who live alone often name as what they miss. Why test: telling someone is the thing wanted, not a step toward it. Swap test: Intimacy is closeness with one person, often a partner; this can be any friend or relative. Flagged against the daily-conversation dream.

someone-i-can-be-completely-honest-with.title: Someone I can be completely honest with
someone-i-can-be-completely-honest-with.line: There's at least one person I can tell the hard or embarrassing things to without editing myself first.
someone-i-can-be-completely-honest-with.writerNotes: Depth without performance: being able to drop the edited version of myself. Why test: honesty with someone is wanted for itself. Swap test: No support is practical help; Intimacy is closeness, often physical or romantic; this is about being fully known in conversation. Flagged against the being-known dream.

friends-who-get-in-touch-with-me-first.title: Friends who get in touch with me first
friends-who-get-in-touch-with-me-first.line: My friends call or text me just to talk, so I'm not always the one who has to start.
friends-who-get-in-touch-with-me-first.writerNotes: Reciprocity: the connection runs both ways. Why test: being sought out is part of being known and valued, not a means to another loneliness outcome. Swap test: Old friends is about drift from specific past friends; this is about whichever friends I have now. Distinct from every other dream, which do not say who initiates.

seeing-people-who-know-me-in-person.title: Seeing people who know me in person
seeing-people-who-know-me-in-person.line: Most weeks I'm in the same room as a friend who knows me well, not just trading messages.
seeing-people-who-know-me-in-person.writerNotes: In-person presence, which many lonely people lack even with plenty of messages. Why test: being with someone face to face is wanted for itself. Swap test: Plans is about having someone to go out with to do things; this is about time together with someone who knows me, wherever it happens. Flagged against the daily-conversation dream.

feeling-close-to-the-people-i-live-with.title: Feeling close to the people I live with
feeling-close-to-the-people-i-live-with.line: The people I share a home with know what's on my mind, because we talk about more than chores and schedules.
feeling-close-to-the-people-i-live-with.writerNotes: Loneliness inside a full household, a common case the other dreams miss because they assume I'm alone. Why test: closeness at home is the end state. Swap test: Relationship is about conflict with a partner; this covers roommates, family, or a partner when nobody is fighting but nobody really talks.

time-alone-that-doesnt-feel-lonely.title: Time alone that doesn't feel lonely
time-alone-that-doesnt-feel-lonely.line: When I spend an evening on my own, I enjoy the quiet, because I know I'll be talking with people who care about me soon.
time-alone-that-doesnt-feel-lonely.writerNotes: The end state from the solitude side: being alone stops hurting. Why test: wanted for itself. Swap test: no neighboring pain is about how solitude feels. Distinct because every other dream describes time with people; this one describes time without them.

overlaps.reason: Being able to tell one person everything may be the same end state as having people who know what's going on with me.
People who know what's going on with me would likely notice if I went quiet, so one may contain the other.
Telling someone about my day each evening may be the same thing as talking most days with someone who knows me.
Both describe regular contact with people who know me, differing mainly in whether it is in person.
